messages.subject: R Users Group meeting tomorrow
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We are meeting at our normal time tomorrow (1/31) from 10am-noon in the Datalab classroom (360 Shields library). This meeting is to help folks who come in with R programming questions, so come join us and we'll figure out how to help you. This is a hybrid meeting so you can also join us via Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09 I'm still testing COVID-positive so I will be remote again tomorrow.

Also remember that we have a hybrid workshop on debugging in R this Thursday from 10-12 in the Shields classroom. You can sign up here for either Zoom or in-person: https://reservations.library.ucdavis.edu/event/11931826

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators 



For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website for more information.

-- 
Check out our R resources at https://d-rug.github.io/
And please post questions/comments at https://d-rug.discourse.group/
